rules.description: At least five payload-bearing OpenFlow transport segments; decode their message types and inspect installed rules separately.
Non-controller IP frames are present; this count does not prove firewall policy.

manual_checks: Identify both data hosts and ingress/egress interfaces. Correlate allowed exchanges and blocked attempts with the installed rules and capture windows.
R1 R2: Correlate decoded OpenFlow messages and flow-table entries; payload segments alone do not identify a FlowMod.
R3: Record both capture points, allowed replies, blocked-flow counter and absence of the denied delivery in the declared window.
